description: One of the first two Carabineros de Chile helicopters (1969, CC-ECK / C-08), sold to a private owner in 1981 as CC-PNF and damaged in a 1987 accident near Vitacura; the remains, still in the CC-PNF scheme, serve as study material at the Complejo Educacional La Reina technical school (tallyho.cl, October 2019).
museum_name: Complejo Educacional La Reina FH-1100 Instructional Airframe
